summary: Backend regression: 35/35 pytest tests passed (test_linkchat_backend.py + test_new_features.py) — no backend changes this iteration. Frontend (Playwright, Chromium 1920x1080): Age Gate flow fully works — age-gate shows on first load, under-13 date (2020-01-01) + age-confirm-button → age-blocked-title visible, age-retry-button returns to form, 13+ date (2000-01-01) dismisses gate, localStorage lc_age_verified=1 persisted, reload keeps gate dismissed. Landing: hero 'Conecte-se através de um link', 'Como funciona', 'Recursos', 'Planos', FAQ (rendered as 'Perguntas frequentes') all render. hero-primary-cta and plan-cta-pro both navigate to /auth while logged out. Plans billing toggle: Pro shows R$19 (billing-month) and R$190 (billing-year); plan-free/plan-pro/plan-community cards all visible. Login alice@test.com/pass1234 lands at /app. Top bar: topbar-conversas/topbar-servidores/topbar-home-button all visible; Conversas switches to DM view (renders DM list with new navy/cyan theme), Servidores click works, topbar-home-button navigates back to '/'. Theme recolor verified visually — navy bg (#070d22-ish), cyan accents, no coral/green remnants seen. Message send via Enter key in a channel worked (regression ok).
critical_code_review_comments: AgeGate.js: uses UTC date math but new Date() returns local — minor timezone edge case near midnight UTC could shift age by 1 day. Non-critical.
App.js: ageOk state is initialized once from localStorage synchronously — fine, but if user clears storage in another tab, gate won't re-trigger until navigation. Acceptable for MVP.
LandingPage.js (281 lines) is approaching the 'single long file' smell — consider splitting Hero/Pricing/FAQ into separate section components for maintainability.
Previous iteration comments still apply: @app.on_event deprecated, GET /api/files/{path} unauthenticated, voice_signals/typing collections lack TTL indexes.
test_credentials: alice@test.com / pass1234 (bob@test.com / pass1234 also available). Bypass age gate in automation via localStorage.setItem('lc_age_verified','1') or fill age-birthdate-input with 2000-01-01.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Reused existing alice@test.com account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Age gate persists via localStorage key 'lc_age_verified'. On fresh browser session Playwright will see the gate — fill age-birthdate-input with 'YYYY-MM-DD' and click age-confirm-button. The FAQ section's heading is 'Perguntas frequentes' (Portuguese), not literal 'FAQ' — search by that string if asserting. Landing has anchors: #inicio, #recursos, #planos, #faq. Pro plan prices: R$19/mês (billing-month) and R$190/ano (billing-year). Top bar in /app: topbar-conversas (DM mode), topbar-servidores (opens server or create-server modal if none), topbar-home-button (navigates to '/'). alice has 2 personal servers in the rail (letters 'IN', 'UI') but rail buttons use data-testid pattern that didn't match [data-testid^='rail-server-'] in my probe — not a bug, just a selector note. Backend unchanged; existing pytest suites fully pass.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 5 requested feature groups (age gate, landing, plans, top bar, regression) pass.
